question: How did the lithium content of the NMC622 change after delamination?
rendered: The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials was reduced from 1.015 to 0.993 after delamination, most probably due to the lithium leaching in the delamination and washing steps.

source.file: ChemSusChem - 2020 - Bai - Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium‐Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode.pdf
